tagline: Eat what you have. Waste less, every day.
have_account: Already have an account? Sign in
new_account: New to EatMe? Create an account
verify_email: Check your email to verify your account, then sign in.
reset_sent: If an account exists, you will receive email instructions.
development_login: Local development environment. Use fictional data. Email addresses are not verified.
name: What’s your name?
household_question: How many people do you usually cook for?
adult_confirmation: I confirm I am at least 18 years old.
diet_question: How do you like to eat?
diet_hint: Choose one or more styles. You can change them any time.
strictness: How closely do you follow them?
medical_review_note: These profiles, including RAD, become available after their rules and sources are reviewed.
restrictions_hint: Allergies and intolerances are separate from preferences. Only add what you choose to disclose.
health_consent: I consent to using my allergy and intolerance data for the features I request. I can remove them from my profile. EatMe does not replace professional medical advice.
offline_inventory: Saved inventory: it may be out of date. Reconnect to make changes.
empty_fridge_body: Add the food you have at home. We’ll take it from there.
use_by_passed: The use-by date has passed. This batch is excluded from suggested cooking allocations.
no_recipes_body: Try another mode or check the food and quantities in your Fridge.
preference_warning: This recipe differs from a flexible preference.
online_required: Reconnect to check your current profile.
no_known_conflict: No conflict in the available data
nutrition_unavailable: Nutrition values are not yet available. No score is calculated.
check_package: Always check the actual product packaging: the demonstration catalog does not certify the absence of allergens.
evidence_unavailable: No reviewed scientific source is attached to this demonstration record.
demo_data_not_a_safety_guarantee: Assessment based on demonstration data. It is not a safety guarantee for the actual food.
contains_allergen: Contains an allergen declared in your profile.
may_contain_allergen: May contain an allergen in your profile: check the packaging.
diet_exclusion: Conflict with a selected dietary style.
never_suggest: This food is excluded by your preferences.
unknown_ingredient: An ingredient could not be fully identified.
rule_not_evaluable: A rule cannot be evaluated: compatibility is not confirmed.
validation_explanation: Ingredients were checked against the declared restrictions and the rule versions listed below.
missing_ingredients_notice: Some quantities are missing from your Fridge. You can adjust the actual quantities used before confirming.
confirm_consumption_hint: These amounts will be deducted from your Fridge. Tap an ingredient to adjust the actual consumption.
consumption_shortage: Insufficient quantities: update your Fridge or specify what you used from the recorded products.
leftover_date_unknown: Leftovers will be recorded without an automatically estimated expiry date.
privacy_body: Your profile personalizes recipes. Allergy and intolerance data is used only with your consent and is not sent to advertising services. You can remove it by editing your profile and obtain a copy of your recorded data.
delete_confirm: Permanently delete this local account and its inventory? This cannot be undone.
network_error: Connection unavailable. Check your network and try again.
authentication_failed: Sign-in failed. Check your details or try again.
password_length: The password must be 12 to 128 characters long.
account_unavailable: This account is unavailable for registration.
forbidden: You do not have access to this operation.
auth_mode_mismatch: The app’s authentication setup does not match the server.
invalid_profile: Enter your name and confirm you are at least 18.
health_consent_required: Confirm consent to use allergy and intolerance data.
duplicate_diet: The same diet was selected twice.
diet_rules_unavailable: A profile’s rules are unavailable. Review your selected diets.
medical_profiles_not_released: This profile still requires scientific review.
stale_profile: Your profile changed. Refresh before confirming.
stale_inventory: Your Fridge changed. Refresh the summary before confirming.
insufficient_inventory: There is not enough in your inventory.
invalid_quantity: Enter a valid quantity with up to three decimal places.
expiry_type_required: Provide both the date and its meaning.
whole_units_required: Enter a whole number of pieces for this food.
invalid_leftovers: Leftover servings cannot exceed prepared servings.
recipe_not_compatible: This recipe is not compatible with your current profile.
rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.
idempotency_conflict: The request changed. Refresh the screen and try again.
ownership_transfer_required: Manage household ownership before deleting your account.
account_deletion_not_configured: Account deletion is not configured yet.
medical_consent: I consent to using my condition-associated nutrition profile. I understand that EatMe does not replace individualized advice from a physician or dietitian.
medical_consent_required: Confirm the dedicated medical nutrition consent.
